listing.name: Mad Avionics 1.1
listing.summary: This mod is an addon to Diable Avionics adding in 5 ships. Godhead - A 5 module super capital carrier designed to be a glass cannon. Tried to balance it to take on fleets, but can still be lost if you're not careful.
listing.aiSummary: Adds five ships to Diable Avionics, including a super capital carrier, a phase destroyer, and logistics vessels.

description: Adds five ships to Diable Avionics: Godhead, Mirage, Drought, Flood, and one other. These include a glass cannon super capital carrier, a fragile phase destroyer, and capital class mining, tanker, and freighter ships. All ships feature ornate, base, and stripeless paintjobs.
